researchId.title: Research ID
researchId.description: The ID of the research to cancel (off-core research job ID). If not provided, will attempt to retrieve from current session.

PartialReport.title: Partial Report
PartialReport.description: Whether to generate a partial report from completed steps before canceling (true/false). When true, the system creates a report from any research steps that finished before cancellation.

deepResearchWorkflowAction.title: Deep Research Workflow Action
deepResearchWorkflowAction.description: Workflow action identifier ('CANCEL'). Used by the agent topic for routing to the appropriate action.
